timeBaseNote: All times in seconds of the mix mp3 (the file players play). Stem times converted with t_mix = t + offsetAt0 + slope*t (RETURN.md, KFB_MIX_LINEAR).

characters.modelNote: male voice = mummy with light skin and a more male-read hairline (brief P1); WS0 maps Mummy_A/Mummy_B from the image
characters.role: rapper: all 52 card verses (incl. the octave-up register) + 'Pharaoh Piledriver' in the intro (V-365)

characters.modelNote: female voice = mummy with dark face and bright white eyes (brief P1)

clipRules: Clip starts at its `t` (a bar downbeat) from clip time 0 and loops until the next entry. Singer dances (verse: 4-bar chunks A,B,A,C; chorus: 2-bar chunks C,D; intro/outro: 4-bar D,C), the other character holds the idle groove. Break (instrumental): both dance D. Suggested crossfade 0.15 s starting at `t`.

beats.note: t/downbeats/bars = beats.json t_mix / downbeats_mix / bars[].t_mix (mix time). bars[i].t == downbeats[i].

cardEvents.title: Atum
cardEvents.lyric: Here comes Atum, Autogenesis: new rule from thin air; ultimate freelancer, no union dues.

cardEvents.title: Nun
cardEvents.lyric: Nun, Reset Board: return to void; infinite dark water, unscripted pre-show.

cardEvents.title: Shu
cardEvents.lyric: Shu, Wall of Wind: blocks flying attacks, separates tag teams; holding kids apart.

cardEvents.title: Tefnut
cardEvents.lyric: True story: Tefnut, Corrosive Spit: Equipment destroyed; born from a god's loogie.

cardEvents.title: Geb
cardEvents.lyric: You know Geb, Earthquake Laughter: shake table; laugh destroys cities, goose on head.

cardEvents.title: Nut
cardEvents.lyric: Nut, Star Fall: tokens drop; eats sun every night, heartburn central.

cardEvents.title: Ra
cardEvents.lyric: Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, they stopped clapping.

cardEvents.title: Khepri
cardEvents.lyric: My grandmother swore by Khepri, Resurrection Roll, retrieves card? Moves sun like ball of poop. It's a living.

cardEvents.title: Osiris
cardEvents.lyric: Osiris, Undying Popularity: cannot be eliminated; boxed, drowned, chopped up, still biggest pop.

cardEvents.title: Isis
cardEvents.lyric: Isis, Gather the Pieces: reassemble destroyed card; conned sun god for his password.

cardEvents.title: Set
cardEvents.lyric: Set, Sandstorm Sabotage: blind opponent; killed brother over chair shot.

cardEvents.title: Horus
cardEvents.lyric: Horus, Vengeance Strike: double damage against Heel cards; fed uncle salad, secret ingredient.

cardEvents.title: Anubis
cardEvents.lyric: Anubis, Weighing Scale: guess card value, if correct, eliminate it; heavy heart, no club.

cardEvents.title: Ma'at
cardEvents.lyric: Ma'at, Balance Check: equal stats; feather ruins afterlife, no cheating.

cardEvents.title: Ammit
cardEvents.lyric: Nobody warned us about Ammit, Soul Crunch: permanently remove card; hearts of sinners, zero calorie diet.

cardEvents.title: Thoth
cardEvents.lyric: I read a book about Thoth, Wiki-Edit: change Lore; Inventor of writing, knows cheat codes.

cardEvents.title: Sekhmet
cardEvents.lyric: Sekhmet, Rage Virus: attack every card including own; stopped by red beer.

cardEvents.title: Bastet
cardEvents.lyric: Bastet, Claws & Cuddles: heal or scratch; don't touch belly.

cardEvents.title: Montu
cardEvents.lyric: Montu, Trample: ignore defense; Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.

cardEvents.title: Shezmu
cardEvents.lyric: Meanwhile elsewhere: Shezmu, The Squeeze: defeated cards into Perfume; skulls like grapes.

cardEvents.title: Sobek
cardEvents.lyric: Sobek, Ambush Drag: pull opponent's card into River; loves robbery, eats tourists.

cardEvents.title: Tawaret
cardEvents.lyric: What if Tawaret, Mama Bear Smash: threatened Child, stats triple; hippos kill more people.

cardEvents.title: Khnum
cardEvents.lyric: You'll laugh, but Khnum, Clay Clone: duplicate any card; babies out of river mud, original 3D printer.

cardEvents.title: Hapi
cardEvents.lyric: Hapi, High Water: flood board; silt, life, wet socks.

cardEvents.title: Bes
cardEvents.lyric: Bes, Distraction Dance: cannot attack for laughing; ugly and loud, true hero.

cardEvents.title: Medjed
cardEvents.lyric: Medjed, Laser Eyes: shoot beams from eyes; unseen Smiter.

cardEvents.title: Babi
cardEvents.lyric: Do you know Babi, Aggression: attack immediately, ask questions never; eats entrails. Gross.

cardEvents.title: Serket
cardEvents.lyric: Serket, Venom Heal: poison enemies or cure allies; misunderstood scorpions.

cardEvents.title: The Solar Barque
cardEvents.lyric: Did you see the film about The Solar Barque, Night Travel? Skip opponent's turn; millions of years, zero maintenance.

cardEvents.title: The Scales of Justice
cardEvents.lyric: The Scales of Justice, Judgment: lower stat eliminated; hippo eats you if tilted.

cardEvents.title: The Crook & Flail
cardEvents.lyric: The Crook & Flail, Command: control opponent's card; shepherd people, beat grain.

cardEvents.title: The Eye of Ra
cardEvents.lyric: The Eye of Ra, Solar Flare: damage all Chaos cards; ancient remote-controlled drone strike.

cardEvents.title: Seshat
cardEvents.lyric: Seshat, Blueprint: look at top cards; notches lifespan on stick, invented math.

cardEvents.title: Ptah

cardEvents.title: Imhotep
cardEvents.lyric: Imhotep, Polymath: use Manager power; mortal built pyramid, promoted to God.

cardEvents.title: Neith
cardEvents.lyric: Neith, Fate Weave: rearrange hand; wove universe, do not ask her to knit.

cardEvents.title: Apep
cardEvents.lyric: Not a metaphor: Apep, System Crash: end game, nobody wins unless Ra in play; pray against him.

cardEvents.title: The Akhekh
cardEvents.lyric: Behind the locked door: The Akhekh, Desert Terror: Fear status; visual non-sequitur scares tourists.

cardEvents.title: Seven Scorpions
cardEvents.lyric: This one has a rule: Seven Scorpions, Swarm: 7 small attacks; bodyguards, they stung rich lady's son.

cardEvents.title: The Red Cloud
cardEvents.lyric: The Red Cloud, Blindness: accuracy zero; angry breath of Set, red is color of bad things.

cardEvents.title: Nekhbet
cardEvents.lyric: Nekhbet, White Crown: defense with Wadjet; vultures good mothers.

cardEvents.title: Wadjet
cardEvents.lyric: Wadjet, Red Crown: attack with Nekhbet; fire-spitting snake, forehead protection.

cardEvents.title: Shai
cardEvents.lyric: My diary says: Shai, The Script: decide dice outcome before rolling; can't fight booking committee.

cardEvents.title: Renenutet
cardEvents.lyric: Renenutet, Harvest Gold: resources each turn; snakes and milk.

cardEvents.title: The Duat
cardEvents.lyric: Remember The Duat, Graveyard cards attack; Underworld snakes, 12 gates to leave.

cardEvents.title: The Field of Reeds
cardEvents.lyric: They wrote songs about The Field of Reeds, heal all damage at end of turn; Aaru, just like Earth but no taxes.

cardEvents.title: Heliopolis
cardEvents.lyric: Heliopolis, Solar gods get Stats; Ennead board meetings.

cardEvents.title: The Primeval Mound
cardEvents.lyric: The deck insists on The Primeval Mound, High Ground? First solid ground; everything starts here.

cardEvents.title: The Lettuce Incident
cardEvents.lyric: Anyway, The Lettuce Incident, Public Humiliation: opponent loses Cool points; Set ate salad with Horus's dressing. Awkward.

cardEvents.title: The Red Beer Trick
cardEvents.lyric: The Red Beer Trick, Forced Sleep: strongest attacker removed; thought blood, dyed beer.

cardEvents.title: The Missing Piece
cardEvents.lyric: The Missing Piece, Prosthetic Power: replace lost limb with gold; fish ate the 14th.

cardEvents.title: The Extra 5 Days
cardEvents.lyric: Which brings us to The Extra 5 Days, Overtime: extra turn; Thoth won 5 extra days gambling.
